title: Dua e Mahdi
introduction:
DUA AL MAHDI

The Supplication of Imam al-Mahdi(a.s.):

Al-Kaf’ami, in al-Misbah, says “This is the supplicatory prayer of Imam al-Mahdi(a.s.):

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا تَوْفِيْقَ الطَّاعَةِ
verses.translation: O Allah, (please do) grant us success to obey (You),

verses.arabic: وَ بُعْدَ الْمَعْصِيَةِ
verses.translation: remoteness from disobedience (to You),

verses.arabic: وَ صِدْقَ النِّيَّةِ
verses.translation: true intention,

verses.arabic: وَ عِرْفَانَ الْحُرْمَةِ
verses.translation: and identification of sanctity.

verses.arabic: وَ اَكْرِمْنَا بِالْهُدٰى وَ الْاِسْتِقَامَةِ
verses.translation: (Please do) honor us with true guidance and straightforwardness,

verses.arabic: وَ سَدِّدْ اَلْسِنَتَنَا بِالصَّوَابِ وَ الْحِكْمَةِ
verses.translation: dedicate our tongues to truth and wisdom,

verses.arabic: وَ امْلَأْ قُلُوْبَنَا بِالْعِلْمِ وَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ
verses.translation: fill our hearts with knowledge and learning,

verses.arabic: وَ طَهِّرْ بُطُوْنَنَا مِنَ الْحَرَامِ وَ الشُّبْهَةِ
verses.translation: purify our stomachs from illegally and suspiciously gotten food,

verses.arabic: وَ اكْفُفْ اَيْدِيَنَا عَنِ الظُّلْمِ وَ السَّرِقَةِ
verses.translation: withhold our hands from oppression and larceny,

verses.arabic: وَ اغْضُضْ اَبْصَارَنَا عَنِ الْفُجُوْرِ وَ الْخِيَانَةِ
verses.translation: turn our sights away from licentiousness and treachery,

verses.arabic: وَ اسْدُدْ اَسْمَاعَنَا عَنِ اللَّغْوِ وَ الْغِيْبَةِ
verses.translation: and block our hearings against vainness and backbiting,

verses.arabic: وَ تَفَضَّلْ عَلٰى عُلَمَاۤئِنَا بِالزُّهْدِ وَ النَّصِيْحَةِ
verses.translation: confer upon our scholars with asceticism and advice,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَى الْمُتَعَلِّمِيْنَ بِالْجُهْدِ وَ الرَّغْبَةِ
verses.translation: upon the learners with hard work and desire (to learning),

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَى الْمُسْتَمِعِيْنَ بِالْاِتِّبَاعِ وَ الْمَوْعِظَةِ
verses.translation: upon the listeners with following and learning (lessons),

verses.arabic: وَ عَلٰى مَرْضَى الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ بِالشِّفَاۤءِ وَ الرَّاحَةِ
verses.translation: upon the Muslim patients with cure and comfort,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلٰى مَوْتَاهُمْ بِالرَّأْفَةِ وَ الرَّحْمَةِ،
verses.translation: upon the dead Muslims with kindness and mercy,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلٰى مَشَايِخِنَا بِالْوَقَارِ وَ السَّكِيْنَةِ
verses.translation: upon our aged people with somberness and gentleness,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَى الشَّبَابِ بِالْاِنَابَةِ وَ التَّوْبَةِ
verses.translation: upon the youths with turning (to You) and repentance,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَى النِّسَاۤءِ بِالْحَيَاۤءِ وَ الْعِفَّةِ
verses.translation: upon the women with shyness and chastity,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَى الْاَغْنِيَاۤءِ بِالتَّوَاضُعِ وَ السَّعَةِ
verses.translation: upon the rich with modesty and ample giving,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَى الْفُقَرَاۤءِ بِالصَّبْرِ وَ الْقَنَاعَةِ
verses.translation: upon the poor with patience and satisfaction,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَى الْغُزَاةِ بِالنَّصْرِ وَ الْغَلَبَةِ
verses.translation: upon the warriors with triumph and supremacy,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَى الْاُسَرَاۤءِ بِالْخَلَاصِ وَ الرَّاحَةِ
verses.translation: upon the prisoners with release and comfort,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَى الْاُمَرَاۤءِ بِالْعَدْلِ وَ الشَّفَقَةِ
verses.translation: upon the rulers with justice and sympathy,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَى الرَّعِيَّةِ بِالْاِنْصَافِ وَ حُسْنِ السِّيْرَةِ
verses.translation: and upon the subjects with impartiality and good behavior.

verses.arabic: وَ بَارِكْ لِلْحُجَّاجِ وَ الزُّوَّارِ فِيْ الزَّادِ وَ النَّفَقَةِ
verses.translation: (Please do) bless the pilgrims to Mecca and the visitors (of the tombs of the saints) with provision and expenditure,

verses.arabic: وَ اقْضِ مَاۤ اَوْجَبْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الْحَجِّ وَ الْعُمْرَةِ
verses.translation: and help them settle the Hajj and 'Umrah that You have made incumbent upon them,

verses.arabic: بِفَضْلِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ يَاۤ اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔
verses.translation: in the name of Your grace and mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy!
